sentences.en: Last week, I went shopping for new clothes.
sentences.zh: 上周，我去买新衣服了。

sentences.en: I needed a new coat and a pair of shoes.
sentences.zh: 我需要一件新外套和一双鞋。

sentences.en: The first shop had a blue coat, but it was expensive.
sentences.zh: 第一家店有一件蓝色外套，但是很贵。

sentences.en: The second shop had a cheaper coat, but the color was not good.
sentences.zh: 第二家店有一件更便宜的外套，但是颜色不好。

sentences.en: The third shop had the best coat of all.
sentences.zh: 第三家店有最好的一件外套。

sentences.en: It was black and the price was right.
sentences.zh: 它是黑色的，价格合适。

sentences.en: I took it to the front of the shop and paid.
sentences.zh: 我把它拿到店前付了钱。

sentences.en: Then I looked at shoes. I saw a good pair of brown shoes.
sentences.zh: 然后我看了鞋子。我看到一双不错的棕色鞋子。

sentences.en: They were cheaper than I thought.
sentences.zh: 它们比我想象的要便宜。

sentences.en: I gave the money to the man at the desk.
sentences.zh: 我把钱给了柜台前的男人。

sentences.en: I was happy with my new coat and shoes.
sentences.zh: 我对我的新外套和鞋子很满意。

sentences.en: Shopping was a good experience.
sentences.zh: 购物是一个很好的经历。

sentences.en: I got a receipt after I paid for the coat.
sentences.zh: 我付了外套的钱后拿到了一张收据。

sentences.en: I keep an account of all my shopping money.
sentences.zh: 我记录我所有购物的花费。

sentences.en: The rate of tax on clothes was high.
sentences.zh: 衣服的税率很高。

sentences.en: The store made a good profit from the sale.
sentences.zh: 这家店从这次销售中获得了不错的利润。

sentences.en: The loss on the cheap shoes was small.
sentences.zh: 便宜鞋子的亏损很小。

sentences.en: My selection of a blue coat was a good decision.
sentences.zh: 我选择蓝色外套是一个好的决定。

sentences.en: The price was low, so it was a cheap purchase.
sentences.zh: 价格很低，所以这是一次便宜的购买。

sentences.en: The expensive coat was better than the cheap one.
sentences.zh: 昂贵的外套比便宜的好。
